title: Zesty Korean Doenjang Tagine
description: A plant-based, American-inspired twist on traditional Korean doenjang, cooked in a tagine with a fluffy and mustardy flavor profile
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together the doenjang, vegetable oil, garlic, ginger, tagine spice blend, mustard, salt, and black pepper
Add the chopped onion to the bowl and stir until the onion is evenly coated with the doenjang mixture
Transfer the onion mixture to the tagine and arrange the tofu cubes on top
Add the chopped kale to the tagine, covering the tofu and onion mixture
Cover the tagine with a lid and bake for 30 minutes
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the kale is tender and the tofu is lightly browned
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving
Serve the Zesty Korean Doenjang Tagine hot, garnished with additional kale and mustard if desired
